nodes.label: Five Pillars of Islam
nodes.subject: history
nodes.detail: Universal practices accepted by all Muslims: shahada (declaration of faith), namaz/salat (five daily prayers), zakat (alms), sawm (fasting during Ramzan), hajj (pilgrimage to Mecca). In India, overlaid with local customs and sectarian practices (Sunni, Shia, Ismaili).

nodes.label: Sharia Law
nodes.subject: history
nodes.detail: Islamic law governing Muslim community based on Quran, hadis (Prophet's traditions), qiyas (reasoning by analogy) and ijma (community consensus). Ulama expected to ensure rulers governed by sharia. In Indian subcontinent, applied flexibly given diverse non-Muslim populations.
